steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Movement 1 (Evening in the Village) alternates between slow modal folk melody and lively dance — depicts a peaceful evening scene in rural Hungary. | Key Fact: Movement 2 (The Bear Dance) uses heavy, irregular rhythm and rough string techniques to depict a clumsy bear — humour through musical characterisation. | Key Fact: Movement 4 (Slightly Tipsy) depicts drunkenness through unstable rhythm, sliding pitches and wavering dynamics — musical word painting. | Key Fact: Movement 5 (Swineherd's Dance) is fast and rhythmic with virtuosic string writing — folk dance energy translated into orchestral brilliance.
